podcast.body: This collection released in 2006 by the Foo Fighters includes "Marigold," making it the only track to have been released by both Nirvana and the Foo Fighters. "It was also released by the Foo Fighters on the Foo's Skin and Bones collection in 2006"

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This live album featured a performance of "Mera Gold," a song that originated from Dave Grohl's "Late" project and later appeared on a Nirvana CD single. Its inclusion on this album demonstrates the Foo Fighters' willingness to perform material from Dave's earlier, lesser-known works. "In fact, you can find it on the live Skin and Bones album, which came out in 2006."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
